plugins.name: git-cleanup
plugins.description: Audit local branches and worktrees against GitHub PR state, auto-clean safe ones, prompt on the rest.

plugins.name: ridl-lsp
plugins.description: RIDL language server for .ridl schema files

plugins.name: agent-comms
plugins.description: Two agent sessions (e.g. Claude as author, Codex as reviewer) autonomously iterate on an artifact through a single shared file until they converge or hit an impasse, with no human relaying between chats.

plugins.name: codex-review
plugins.description: Run a Codex code review against a GitHub PR (async, in a throwaway worktree), specific files, or the local working tree.

plugins.name: gh-workflow
plugins.description: Authoring GitHub PRs and issues: shared body-composition rules, PR-description and issue-body formats, the gated review pipeline, chained/dependent-PR merge order, and code-review output convention.

plugins.name: land-pr
plugins.description: Drive an open GitHub PR until it is actually merged: rebase, green CI, address human and bot reviews, poll, merge.

plugins.name: go-style
plugins.description: Go style conventions: type design and composition, naming and package-prefix stripping, named returns, error wrapping and translation, unchecked-error marking, hashing/secrets, config-at-startup validation, HTTP-client injection, cmp.Or defaults, struct-literal and pointer-field initialization, time-sensitive tests with testing/synctest, multi-column scan structs, import aliasing, logger naming, test shape, assertion collapsing, parser colocation, Go diff review checklist.

plugins.name: service-skeleton
plugins.description: Go backend service layout: apps/<svc>/ cmd, config, data, domain, rpc, tests plus a root pkg/, patterns, and anti-patterns.

plugins.name: gh-stack
plugins.description: GitHub-native stacked pull requests via the gh-stack CLI extension: create, sync, navigate, and atomically merge PR stacks.

plugins.name: writing-for-humans
plugins.description: The house standard for writing that a human can follow and that reads like a person wrote it. Two axes: readability (concise means simplify not compress, discursive sentences over telegraphic fragments, show-don't-name with worked examples, format by the shape of the information) and voice (the eight tells that mark text as machine-written, plus the author's own measured written register). Apply to any human-facing writing: proposals, PRs, docs, issues, messages.

plugins.name: design-proposal
plugins.description: Structure a decision-ready engineering design proposal: a worth-it gate that sizes the artifact (ticket or PR body vs standalone doc), recommendation-first argument, source-authority discipline (facts vs recommendations), the layered design+plan/spec structure for larger proposals, alternatives, review reconciliation, and the design and rationale split once a proposal lands. Delegates prose quality to writing-for-humans.
